scope: Adopt-mode original MJO VM and native syscall semantics over shared image, glyph, audio, storage and presentation services. Pages/sprites are retained native pictures composed with shared transparency-plane kernels. No original executable execution or hosted engine.

native_module.inspection: Static IDA 9 only; no original program execution

functions.0x410060: syscall hash dispatch; auto_mode_config writes top integer at branch0x411c84
functions.0x403310: is_testplay returns startup mode != 1 through native integer push
functions.0x419500: page_create reads width/top, height/top-1, optional color/top-2
functions.0x4404e0: true-color allocation is24bpp BGR despite wiki claim32; zero storage maps opaque black
functions.0x4404a0: zero fill newly allocated true-color page
functions.0x401c40: rand(bound): original CRT rand()%signed bound; zero bound requires native error-dialog policy, not silently returned here
functions.0x450379: MSVCRT integer stream exactly matches shared SequenceRng::msvc
functions.0x424d06: original srand(time(0)); native startup IO worker captures Unix seconds once; no elapsed-ms replacement
functions.0x401c80: rand! special float profile remains unsupported
functions.0x434cf0: current settings initialize by registry read with ENV defaults
functions.0x4431b0: HKCU Software/REG_GLOBAL/REG_LOCAL REG_SZ integer read; not DWORD
functions.0x4356e0: set_effectspeed current global and persistence, integer0 return
functions.0x41c5f0: conditional CapsLock query/physical key toggle; explicit engine_logical policy clears only shared logical CapsLock, preserving NumLock/ScrollLock; no physical import/control
functions.0x410060-0x81ce0485: fast_mode_disable increments native depth and invokes caps clear
functions.0x409f80: native VM initialization resets fast-disable depth 0 before startup
functions.0x41db40: pushes a type3 native integer value onto VM stack; fast_mode_disable pushes zero
functions.0x40B350: thread loop; click latches 130/131/136 jump frame targets; kill runs destructors
functions.0x40D490: return runs a registered destructor before popping
functions.0x409D90/0x41DD40: RunScript resets thread 0 and enters the module entry
functions.0x419500..0x41BD30: page creation, fills, copies, mod-copy, sepia, alpha tables, pic_unpack
functions.0x447AE0/0x4483F0/0x445700/0x445900: copy, transparency blend, masked blend, additive kernels
functions.0x43C590/0x43C790/0x43CCB0: dirty tiles 160x40, destructive sprite redraw, frame render order
functions.0x43DBE0/0x43CDC0/0x43D660: sprite record, per-frame update, move interpolation
functions.0x43C220/0x4403F0/0x43C260/0x440380: init-time persistence and reset of sprites/pages
functions.0x413360..0x413AC0: fontout state and string drawing with shadow modes
functions.0x42F090/0x42F1B0: hit regions and region poll callbacks
functions.0x41F7A0/0x41FCB0/0x420150/0x424CB0: save point, slot save, load and HOT_RESET main loop
functions.0x437E90..0x43B610: music, sound slot, voice and voice channel handlers

portable_settings.writes: shared StorageWrite owner receipt; no original syscall ACK on admission alone
portable_settings.limits: 1MiB,4096 entries, bounded unique string values; numeric profile rejects unsupported native atoi suffix/overflow strings
